samples.xml_description: Implement a dual-port RAM with a depth of DEPTH and a bit width of WIDTH bits, with all data initialized to 000000. It has two groups of ports, respectively for reading data and writing data, and read and write operations can be carried out at the same time. When the read_en signal is 1, the read_data of the corresponding position is read through the read_addr signal and output; When the write_en signal is 1, data is written to the corresponding position through the write_addr signal and write-data signal. Clock signal used for synchronous operation. Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive. Write enable signal to initiate a write operation. Address for the write operation. Data to be written to the RAM. Read enable signal to initiate a read operation. Address for the read operation. Output signal representing the data read from the RAM. 6. Bit width of data. 8. Depth of the RAM. Register array to store data. Implement a dual-port RAM with a depth of DEPTH and a bit width of WIDTH bits, with all data initialized to 000000. It has two groups of ports, respectively for reading data and writing data, and read and write operations can be carried out at the same time. When the read_en signal is 1, the read_data of the corresponding position is read through the read_addr signal and output; When the write_en signal is 1, data is written to the corresponding position through the write_addr signal and write-data signal. Initialize internal_RAM to 0. Loop through each address in the RAM. 0 DEPTH-1 1 Set each element in internal_RAM to 0. internal_RAM[i] = {WIDTH{1'b0}}; Trigger on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n. posedge clk negedge rst_n Reset internal_RAM to 0 if rst_n is 0. !rst_n Loop through each address in the RAM. 0 DEPTH-1 1 Set each element in internal_RAM to 0. internal_RAM[i] = {WIDTH{1'b0}}; Write write_data to internal_RAM at write_addr if write_en is 1. write_en internal_RAM[write_addr] = write_data; Trigger on positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n. posedge clk negedge rst_n Reset read_data to 0 if rst_n is 0. !rst_n read_data = {WIDTH{1'b0}}; Read data from internal_RAM at read_addr if read_en is 1. read_en read_data = internal_RAM[read_addr];
